verdict.rationale: The GST portal homepage links to a grievance tracker ('Log/Track Your Issues here Grievance Redressal'), which is a first-party way to check the status of a grievance case. Nothing in the evidence documents status lookup for returns, registration applications, refunds, appeals or notices from public pages; the dashboard item covers downloading certificates and notices, not checking status. Missing for 10: documented public status tracking for returns, registration applications, refunds and appeals, evidence the tracker works without login, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages
